items: When you start the party at your decks, the burst of sparkles, the pillar of light and the dome are gone: a rainbow audio analyser ring, like the soundsystem spell's, now spreads across the Terrace's floor around the decks, moves with the music, and fades a bar after the music drops

The analyser ring at your decks now reads as separate bars that rise and fall with the music, jump with each scratch of your needle-drop routine before the music starts, and stay on the Terrace's floor instead of hanging over its edge
